description: Choose which branch to follow at a mastery path (conditional release) point in a module. Unlocks that branch's assignments and may not be reversible. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

assignment_set_id.description: ID of the mastery path option to choose, from get_module_item.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

item_id.description: Module item ID (numeric string). Get it from list_module_items.

module_id.description: Module ID (numeric string). Get it from list_modules.

name: select_mastery_path
title: Select Mastery Path
